$comment: Accepted mutants of tools/relay_mutation_gate.py that are by design or recorded follow-ups. `route`, `mutation` and each `path` are fnmatch patterns (`*` spans path separators); an entry that matches no finding fails the gate. Follow-ups are listed in docs/merge-tooling.md.

entries.reason: Content Lean computes (a list, text or map whose length and text the runners decide: orders, premises, reports, rendered lines, optional ids written empty): the client checks binding and well-formedness only (ve/backends/lean_service_schema/README.md, threat model); an emptied or repeated element is a well-formed answer. Request-bound lists (x-rows, x-length, x-zip, x-count) and request names are refused and are not covered here.
